class_requirement.requirement: Low stepping Spider gait, never resting on the belly; slow tracking is permitted by the handout.

native.scope: Actual native9hull nominal contacts, sampled52Hz; forces precede postintegration pose by at most1/520s. Base velocity during support is a sliding proxy, not actual contact-point slip. No ROS/hardware.

physical_contract.meaning: Engineering command bound from motion guidance, not a hardware speed rating
physical_contract.gpu_collision_model: single torso hull plus foot collisions
physical_contract.native_collision_model: all nine ground hulls plus foot collisions

decision: Weight -2 produces a substantial required-behavior improvement but remains an exploratory candidate: some randomized idle worlds sustain torso support, turn impacts remain, and braking/effort tradeoffs require review. Continue a matched unchanged -2 versus -5 study from the same new penalty checkpoint. Neither arm is installed.
limitations: One training seed, three randomized evaluation seeds; correlated samples do not establish hardware failure probability.
Nominal mechanics retains sensor noise, latency and reset randomness; it is not a perfect noiseless robot.
Sensor/native calibration is steady-state; uncapped contact impacts remain simulator-specific.
Class requirement is a low stepping gait off the belly; no-reset alone is insufficient.
Native complete handoff now includes actual shipped standing walking-controller reactivation, forward motion and stop; no measured-state reset. Nominal only.
Old native traces report base-speed-during-load only as a sliding proxy; exact contact-point velocity telemetry is being added separately.
Single training seed; evaluation rows/three idle segments from the same world are correlated, not independent success trials.
Peak contact impulses are simulator-specific; steady-state force calibration does not validate real impact loads.
A sampled 0.1mm penetration threshold misses sustained static support; force history is the relevant metric.
Native controller activation resets the slew seed to measured clipped joints: target change at the reset is distinct from within-activation slew bounds.
A stronger penalty must be evaluated jointly with tracking, stopping, tilt, flight, force peaks and effort; reward increase is not a promotion criterion.

GPU mean_contact_slip_m_s is the contacted foot-site horizontal-speed metric used in the class evaluator; it omits rigid-body rotation at the contact point. Exact native contact-point velocity is now separately measured and tested.

next_study.hypothesis: A stronger bounded actual torso-load penalty reduces persistent support in randomized worlds without changing reference pose or deployed physical contract.
next_study.evaluation: Same three32-world command grids and384 stops per arm, plus nominal mechanics and exact native complete chain for selected candidates.
next_study.metrics: Persistent >10% bodyweight support episodes longer than1s, normal-load distribution and all command/stop/effort/flight/clipping metrics; no reset and finite target bounds remain necessary. No metric-alone automatic promotion.

result.method: Second standalone raw-array recomputation; no summarize_trace, torso_support summary or previous analyzer functions imported. Float64 reductions; exhaustive endpoint-inclusive stop windows.
result.metric_caveat: GPU mean_contact_slip_m_s is contacted foot SITE horizontal speed, not exact rigid-body contact-point slip. Native exact contact Jacobian telemetry is separate.

result.scope: Actual saved9hull Pupper model, fixed reviewed stop target; one trajectory samples isolated-copy contact telemetry every10physicssteps and the paired trajectory does not. No learned controller or ROS execution in this measurement-invariance check.

support_time_convention.scope: Consecutive above-threshold samples are observations, not proof of between-sample continuity. GPU values are means over the preceding20ms physics interval; native original values are instantaneous pre-integration force samples52Hz. Bin coverage N*dt and observed first-to-last span (N-1)*dt are reported separately.
support_time_convention.historical_fields: Earlier maximum_contiguous_loaded_s and maximum_contiguous_loaded_world_s values are bin-duration counts. Use this addendum observed spans; do not claim continuous contact duration from either.

idle_load_distribution.scope: Every scored stationary world/segment mean, including light sustained torso support. Thresholds0.1%,1%,10% bodyweight are descriptive diagnostic bins, not course or hardware approval thresholds. Repeated stationary segments within one world are correlated.
